name: Research intake ledger
description: Inventory of every item gathered in a data refresh, whether or not it was accepted into the datasets. Items are proposals until their disposition is 'accepted'. 'verification' is the collecting agent's own check; 'independent_review' is filled in by a separate fact-check.

batches.baseline: datalake/bci-landscape.json as of 2026-04-29 (67 companies) and an unpublished 2026-08-13 revision (70 companies)

independent_review.method: Quorum panel review, plus direct re-resolution of every DOI and arXiv ID, re-fetch of the sources behind changed values, and a re-read of the Bagley PDF.
independent_review.citations: No fabricated citation found. All 53 live DOIs and 29 arXiv IDs resolved with matching title, first author and year. C57 and C88 (existing catalogue entries) do not resolve.

prose_claims_blocked.claim: research-delta.md "What changed" item 3 ("threat vectors TARA does not list ... federated poisoning")
prose_claims_blocked.why: Contradicted for federated poisoning by T0024. Holds for model stealing and registry substitution (no registrar hit found by the panel). Reword to "no dedicated entry for model stealing or registry substitution".

prose_claims_blocked.claim: market-delta.md "46% ... same spread the dataset already shows for 2024"
eeg-delta.md schema gap 2 ("Proposals leave these null")
prose_claims_blocked.why: JSON sets security_posture "none_published" and company_category "established" for Nissan and Hyundai Mobis; only funding, valuation and headcount are null.

independent_review.note_on_blocked: BLOCKED verdicts are statements in the delta reports contradicted by the artifacts' own files or by the baseline, not fabricated sources. Raw files are kept unedited as the record of what was collected; the ledger carries the verdict.
independent_review.coverage_gaps: Not re-checked: research items R-046, R-093, R-094; nine market items already self-marked unverified; five EEG items; three NVD lookups that hit a rate limit. Quorum ran with 4 panelists per artifact and no debate round.

items.summary: Broadest 2026 empirical attack study found; preprint, so evidence weight is limited until peer review.

independent_review.checked: arXiv match (5 authors); HTML full text VII-A to VII-C: plain-text BLE frames captured on all three devices; 10-trigger EEGNet avg ASR 97.80, DeepSleepNet 20.0; forgery up to 61.0% (subject 9; subject 3 48.0%), cross-subject/device 44.7-52.3% vs 33.3% chance; "we therefore make no claim of arbitrary code execution" (V4).
independent_review.note: 61.0% is the best of two subjects ("up to" in the paper). MitM was shown for the NeuroSky and Muse apps, not all three devices (see md delta 2 record).
